assets.name: auth-register-membership
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Design ONE exceptionally well art-directed, production-ready 3D registration icon for Zainlak, a premium business, travel and commerce platform. The concept is "your new membership", expressed as an elegant sculptural personal membership card. It must feel like an exquisite branded object, warm and approachable but prestigious, with playful softness only in the geometry.

Composition: a single thick softly rounded upright membership card, slightly tilted clockwise, viewed almost frontally with just enough perspective to see the beautiful thick left edge and upper edge. The card is a sculpted deep teal and jade object with a luminous satin teal face, subtle frosted translucency along the rounded rim, no distracting glass reflections. A beautifully modeled warm-ivory abstract head-and-shoulders profile is inset into the face as raised smooth ceramic relief. The head is a simple soft orb, the shoulders a generous continuous curved form, no eyes or clothing or realistic person. Beneath it exactly two short quiet embossed strokes, broad and sparse. At the LOWER RIGHT corner, one small but prominent thick orange-red PLUS emerges seamlessly across the card edge; it has immaculate rounded square-cut ends and soft shaded depth. Plus is integrated into the composition, not in a circular bubble. A short sculpted flowing teal fold curls behind the lower LEFT edge, subtly recalling a ribbon brand mark; only one restrained fold, not a bow, no orbit ring, no crescent wrapping around a person.

Hierarchy and proportions: card and ivory profile 85% of the visual mass, orange plus 15%. Tall rounded-square silhouette, simple legibility at 140dp. The profile and plus unmistakably communicate CREATE ACCOUNT. No literal celebration objects. No book, open booklet, passport pages, pens, confetti, stars, party cone, gift, crown, lock, key, arrows, buttons, UI mockup or extra props.

Style: high-end modern cartoon 3D with deliberate graphic simplicity, substantial softly beveled silhouettes, tactile satin materials, graceful dimensional modeling, precise studio lighting, extremely smooth gradients, restrained gloss, no plasticky toy shine. Sophisticated designer product rendering, all edges softly rolled. Brand teal #0aa38a with richer emerald side faces, luminous jade rim, warm ivory profile, saturated orange-red #f16a2c accent. Strong tasteful light/dark material contrast. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark.

Background: genuinely transparent alpha with absolutely no backdrop, floor, ground cast shadow, aura, large bloom or background circle. Local contact shading within the object is fine. Square canvas. Entire object and plus inside central 76% of canvas, equal breathing room, nothing cropped. One finished icon only, not a sheet, presentation or alternatives.
